$comment: Source of truth for the Cloudflare MCP portal mapping of server `projects` (mctlhq/.github#35). Every tool this server registers must appear here with an explicit decision; tests/portal-allowlist.test.ts fails the build otherwise. An enabled tool must carry a `reason` that says what it exposes or changes and why that is acceptable on a shared surface. Note what this portal is NOT: customers reach this server by its direct URL, never through the portal, so the portal surface here is the owner's own and nothing on it is a customer-facing decision. Apply with the same operator-run flow as the other upstreams (mctl-telegram scripts/portal-allowlist-apply.sh, one file per server).

tools.name: projects_list
tools.reason: Returns the projects the caller holds a grant on and the level held on each. It is the caller's own access, never anybody else's, and an ungranted project is absent rather than named.

tools.name: projects_outline
tools.reason: Returns one project's table of contents as far as the caller's level reaches; the names of closed sections and the reasons they are closed stay behind internal.

tools.name: projects_search
tools.reason: Full-text search over one project, filtered to the caller's level by the same single decision point as every other read, with snippets drawn only from chunks that level may see.

tools.name: projects_read
tools.reason: Returns one document the caller's level may read; a document above that level answers exactly as one that does not exist, so the tool cannot be used to enumerate.

tools.name: projects_contacts
tools.reason: Returns the people and channels a project's manifest marks visible at the caller's level. Personal handles and operational channels are internal unless the manifest says otherwise.

tools.name: projects_status
tools.reason: Returns liveness and version for one project from the source its manifest names. Below internal it carries no hostname, namespace or address of that source.

tools.name: projects_admin_grants
tools.reason: Returns the whole access table, including every customer's address. Registered on the portal by owner decision 2026-09-19: what the portal catalogue carries is the tool's name and schema, which name nobody, and the server admits the call only from an address in ADMIN_EMAILS, which the portal neither sets nor can influence.

tools.name: projects_admin_change
tools.reason: Works out one change to the access table and hands back the YAML to commit; it writes nothing anywhere, by design, so that access lives in one place. Same owner decision and same ADMIN_EMAILS gate as projects_admin_grants.
